description: Solves a 9x9 sudoku via backtracking. Input: 81 characters row by row with 1-9 for givens and 0/./_ for empty cells (whitespace and separators are ignored), passed inline, via --file, or on stdin. Reports whether the solution is unique. Online version: https://puzzletide.com/sudoku

file.description: Read the grid from a file
